'''Seek Ryontarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who was active in the final [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Disappearing before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], Ryontarr was discovered over half a century later in a [[Sinkhole Station|space station]] deep within [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].

==Biography==
Seek Ryontarr was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and eventually went onto [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduate]] before being selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. After Ryontarr passed his [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and was elevated to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the High Council assigned Ryontarr many missions that took him across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One such assignment took him to [[Nath Goordi]], where the death of the planet's ruler placed the lives of the throne's [[Nath Goordian heirs|heirs]] in danger. Resolving the conflict, Ryontarr was known to have left the planet, but never returned to the Temple on Coruscant.<ref name="FOTJ" />

Deeming his disappearance a mystery, the [[Curator of Records]] placed Ryontarr on the roster of missing Jedi, which made its way into the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]] before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As the Jedi Order was abolished during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], all memory of Ryontarr seemed lost until the ancient artifact was rediscovered after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by the leader of the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Order]]. Investigating its mysteries, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came across Ryontarr's name as he scanned the text for clues as to any surviving Jedi's location.<ref name="FOTJ" />

Nearly a [[43 BBY/Legends|decade later]], Master Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] were investigating a disturbance in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] when the pair stumbled across the mysterious [[Sinkhole Station]]; the same station Skywalker's wayward nephew had visited five years before. Exploring the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the Skywalkers discovered a group of people known as the [[Mind Walkers]], many of them seemingly empty shells. Among them, Ryontarr was the most amicable to speak and introduced Master Skywalker to the techniques used by the Mind Walkers. Ryontarr convinced Skywalker to travel with him to a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] called [[beyond shadows]] to discover what Skywalker's nephew [[Darth Caedus]] had seen when he visited the site five years before. While beyond shadows, Ryontarr's body [[Death/Legends|died]], but his Force essence still served as a guide to the elder Skywalker to the many places beyond shadows which Caedus had seen half a decade prior.<ref name="FOTJ" />
